title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering to prevent regional failover thrashing
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: During a recent incident (see SUP-1123) the SLO enforcer could enter a pathological backoff/ordering loop when regional capacity fluctuations coincided with concurrent circuit-breaker transitions. This produced repeated regional failovers and aggressive load-shedding, causing higher error rates and increased tail latency for customers. This hotfix fixes the core race in backoff ordering and makes the enforcer more conservative about immediate region switches. Summary of changes: - Fix ordering/race in BackoffManager when multiple regions are evaluated concurrently; ensure deterministic arbitration and a minimum stabilization window before triggering a regional failover. - Add an integration test that reproduces the thrashing pattern by driving synthetic region latencies and verifying the enforcer stabilizes. - Harden metric emission around SLO decision points and add tracing spans to make future incidents diagnosable. - Add a temporary feature flag (slo_enforcer.stable_failover=true) defaulted on to allow quick rollout control. - Update helm values and dashboards. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce thrash pattern in integration test - [x] Add unit tests for ordering path - [x] Run full CI (unit + integration) - [x] Handed off to SRE for staging rollout (Lin) Related: Linear ENG-2345 (enforcer thrashing), ENG-2346 (regional failover diagnostics), SUP-1123 (customer incident). This description is continuous; see review comments below for discussion and validation notes.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) enforcer: deterministic arbitration + stabilization window (backoff_manager.rs) 2) tests: integration/regional_failover.rs reproducer + unit tests 3) infra: helm values flag + dashboard updates
release_notes: Fixes a race in the SLO enforcer that could cause regional failover thrashing. Adds a stabilization window to regional failover decisioning and improved observability. No API changes. Backwards-compatible behavioral fix.
review_comments: Michael Torres: Found a potential NPE when region list is empty; added a guard and unit test in a follow-up commit.
Lin Zhang: Can we make the stabilization window configurable per-customer? Reply: added helm value and feature flag; left default conservative to avoid regressions.
María Gonzalez: Integration test looks flakey on slower CI runners. Reply: increased timeouts and added a deterministic seed for the synthetic latency driver; CI run now stable.
SRE (Lin Zhang): Staging rollout verified; no thrash observed during 30m soak with synthetic load. Approved for prod.
Author (Priya): Added tracing spans and metric labels requested by María to aid post-incident debugging.
merge_commit_message: hotfix(slo-enforcer): stabilize backoff ordering and add integration test to prevent regional failover thrashing\n\nFixes ENG-2345, fixes SUP-1123
ci_timeline_notes: Initial CI run: unit tests failed (ordering unit) -> pushed additional guard and test; second CI run passed (unit + integration on self-hosted runners).
qa_notes: Staging rollout with feature flag enabled for 24h across two regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1). Verified metrics: reduced failover rate, no increased latency. SRE ran canary traffic and validated fallback policies still function.
post_deploy_monitoring: Added temporary alert slo_enforcer.failover_rate > 1/min sustained for 5m; added dashboard panel showing stabilization_window and arbitration_decision traces.
notes_for_release_manager: This is a behavioral hotfix and should be included in the next patch release. No schema or API changes. Recommend cherry-pick to latest release branch if needed.
